hec.rss.model

Class SystemStorageZone

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.util.Observable
      • hec.lang.NamedType
        • hec.rss.model.SystemStorageZone
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    AsciiSerializable, FieldAccessor, AltInputReportInfc, java.io.Serializable, java.lang.Cloneable, java.lang.Comparable, java.util.Observer, rma.lang.Modifiable

    public class SystemStorageZone
extends NamedType
implements java.io.Serializable, AsciiSerializable, java.lang.Cloneable, AltInputReportInfc
    SystemStorageZone - Represents the storage zone model for a system of reservoirs. The System storage zone is a combination of upper and lower bound storage zone for all reservoirs in the system. It also contains a list of %storage for each reservoir in the system.
    Author:
    Shannon Newbold, RMA 06/2000
    See Also:
